saucelings.title: Saucelings
saucelings.subtitle: Your characters look after a little companion; you cover the gaps.
saucelings.nav.label: Saucelings views
saucelings.tab.menagerieNew: Menagerie, a new egg is waiting
saucelings.empty.title: No sauceling in the nook yet
saucelings.empty.body: Pick a character to look after a sauceling. They'll bring an egg that looks like something they would find.
saucelings.empty.houseCaretakerNote: You have no characters yet, so the House Caretaker looks after it. Make a character to choose your own.
saucelings.empty.mari: Ooh, an empty nook! Pick a character and they'll bring you an egg to raise together (I can't wait to see what hatches).
saucelings.egg.name: Egg
saucelings.egg.about: Nobody knows what is inside yet. Keep it warm and talk to it. Once someone has cared for it, it hatches in about half an hour.
saucelings.egg.moveLabel: Egg. Drag it, or use the arrow keys, to move it.
saucelings.egg.moveHint: Drag the egg to move it, or tap where it should go.
saucelings.pet.sauceAbout: {{sauce}} sauce: {{readsAs}}. Its sauce changes with how it is looked after.
saucelings.pet.temperamentAbout: {{temperament}}: {{readsAs}}. It takes after {{after}}, and slowly picks up the ways of whoever looks after it.
saucelings.pet.temperamentForming: Its temperament is still taking shape.
saucelings.pet.mealsTitle: Meals {{name}} gave in the last 7 days
saucelings.pet.keptWarmTitle: Times {{name}} kept the egg warm in the last 7 days
saucelings.meter.warmthHelp: Eggs need to stay warm. Use Warm when it gets cold.
saucelings.meter.hatchingHelp: Fills up on its own. Once someone has cared for the egg, it hatches about half an hour after it arrived.
saucelings.meter.hungerHelp: Feed it to keep this up. A hungry sauceling stops growing until it's fed.
saucelings.meter.moodHelp: Play and cuddles lift it. A happy sauceling may get the chance to evolve once in its life.
saucelings.meter.bondHelp: Grows every time anyone cares for it. It needs enough bond to grow into its next stage.
saucelings.nudge.heading: Ask {{name}} to
saucelings.retire.confirmNote: Retire {{name}} to the Menagerie? The nook will be free for a new egg, and you can bring {{name}} back later.
saucelings.swap.note: {{name}} will move to the Menagerie, and the caretaker you pick brings a new egg.
saucelings.swap.noteEgg: The egg will move to the Menagerie, and the caretaker you pick brings a new one.
saucelings.swap.wait: One new egg a day. The next one is ready at {{time}}.
saucelings.unlocks.title: Special saucelings · {{have}} of {{total}} unlocked
saucelings.unlocks.prismite: Prismite: raise {{need}} saucelings to elder or evolve them ({{have}} so far).
saucelings.unlocks.thundrake: Thundrake: care for your saucelings {{need}} times ({{have}} so far).
saucelings.unlocks.clockrit: Clockrit: care for a sauceling on {{need}} different days ({{have}} so far).
saucelings.unlocks.done: {{name}}: unlocked. A new egg may be one.
saucelings.unlocks.halloween: Wickwisp, Cauldrop and Webbit: October only.
saucelings.unlocks.halloweenNow: Wickwisp, Cauldrop and Webbit: it's October, so a new egg may be one.
saucelings.menagerie.empty: No saucelings in the Menagerie yet.
saucelings.menagerie.emptyHow: Saucelings come here when you retire them or swap them for a new egg. Eggs your characters find while chatting wait here too.
saucelings.menagerie.lockStageHelp: It grew all the way up, so it can come back at any age it reached. It stays that age from then on.
saucelings.menagerie.releaseNote: Release {{name}} for good? It leaves the Menagerie and can't come back. Its paintings stay in the Album.
saucelings.menagerie.releaseNoteEgg: Release this egg for good? It leaves the Menagerie and can't come back.
saucelings.menagerie.swapNote: {{active}} will move to the Menagerie, and {{name}} comes back to the nook.
saucelings.menagerie.chooseFirst: Choose who looks after it first.
saucelings.album.needsConnection: Pick an image connection in Saucelings settings first.
saucelings.album.off: Turn on image generation in Settings to paint your sauceling.
saucelings.album.noPet: Bring a sauceling into the nook to paint it.
saucelings.album.full: The Album is full at {{limit}} paintings. Delete one to paint another.
saucelings.album.emptyHint: Use the Paint button above to make the first one.
saucelings.album.caption: {{stage}}, {{date}}
saucelings.album.missing: This painting could not be loaded.
saucelings.album.keepsakeNote: Kept when a sauceling evolves: how it looked before and after.
saucelings.album.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. sitting in a teacup at a café, rain outside
saucelings.album.instructionsNote: Your words replace the plain background. Leave it empty for a plain portrait.
saucelings.form.paintingNote: Painting it now with your image connection.
saucelings.form.repaintHint: For when the picture came out wrong.
saucelings.form.repaintNote: Paint every stage again in one new picture? The one you see now stays until the new one is ready.
saucelings.form.undoRepaintHint: Goes back to the pictures from before the last repaint. Press it again to bring the repaint back.
saucelings.form.eggFailed: The egg could not be painted: {{error}} Bring it to the nook to paint it there.
saucelings.form.needed: Its caretaker invented it, so this stage has no picture until one is painted.
saucelings.form.failed: The painting could not be cut out into a form. Try again.
saucelings.form.offerEggBody: This egg has no picture yet. Painting it uses your image connection.
saucelings.form.offerBody: {{name}} has no picture for this stage yet. Painting it uses your image connection.
saucelings.figure.hint: Draws them in eight poses as a pixel figure in the pets' style, from their avatar and card.
saucelings.figure.confirmNote: Paint {{name}} as a pixel figure with your image connection? It takes one image request, and what the Nook shows now stays until it is ready.
saucelings.figure.failed: The picture could not be read as drawings of {{name}}. Try again.
saucelings.figure.threePoses: {{name}} has three poses so far. Repaint for all eight.
saucelings.figure.undoHint: Goes back to the figure from before the last repaint. Press it again to bring the repaint back.
saucelings.flip.label: Flip {{name}}
saucelings.flip.note: Turns {{name}} to face the other way in the Nook. Nothing is repainted.
saucelings.settings.careWindowNote: How often the caretaker may feed, play or cuddle (default 6 h).
saucelings.settings.connectionNote: The connection the caretaker writes journal lines and check-ins with.
saucelings.settings.budgetNote: Lines you ask for with a click (Check in, hello, welcome back, farewell) don't count. Past the limit, the caretaker uses saved lines.
saucelings.settings.writeEveryLineNote: Every line comes from the model, not the phrasebook. More model calls; the daily limit doesn't apply.
saucelings.settings.imagesNote: Adds Paint and Generate buttons, and paints each creature a caretaker invents, with the image connection you pick.
saucelings.settings.threeDrawingFallback: If a figure doesn't come out, ask once more for three drawings in a row. Helps weaker image models; one extra image call.
saucelings.settings.eggHuntingNote: A character replying in a chat may find an egg for the Menagerie. Only a chance is rolled: no chat text is read and nothing is added to the prompt.
saucelings.settings.imageConnectionEmpty: No image generation connection yet. Add one under Connections.
saucelings.settings.resetNote: Clear the nook, the Menagerie, the Album, saved backgrounds, caretakers' voices and painted figures, and special-egg progress. Your settings stay.
saucelings.journal.speaker: {{name}}:
saucelings.journal.empty: Nothing in the journal yet. Feed, play or cuddle {{name}} and it shows up here.
saucelings.widget.emptyHint: Tap to open Saucelings and pick a caretaker.
saucelings.error.restart: Restart Marinara Engine to finish installing Saucelings.
saucelings.error.network: Couldn't reach Marinara Engine. Check that it's running, then try again.
saucelings.error.timeout: That took too long. Try again in a moment.
saucelings.error.writing: The writing connection didn't answer. Check it in Settings, or try again in a moment.
saucelings.error.engine: Something went wrong on the Engine side. Try again in a moment.
saucelings.background.title: Nook background
saucelings.background.suggestPlain: No writing connection answered, so this is a plain starting point. Edit it as you like.
saucelings.background.off: Turn on image generation in Settings to generate a background.
saucelings.background.noConnection: Pick an image connection in Saucelings settings first.
saucelings.background.sharedNote: Saved backgrounds are shared by all your saucelings.
saucelings.background.deleteNote: Delete “{{label}}” for good? Saucelings showing it go back to their built-in background.
saucelings.background.full: The library is full at {{limit}}. Delete a background to save another.
saucelings.caretaker.idleEgg: I'm keeping an eye on the egg.
saucelings.about.refreshVoiceNote: Reads their character card again, so their lines sound like them.
saucelings.about.handOverNote: Hand {{name}} over to {{caretaker}}? They'll do the caring from now on.
saucelings.about.handOverEggNote: Hand the egg over to {{caretaker}}? They'll do the caring from now on.
saucelings.help.label: Show help: {{action}}
saucelings.evolve.note: {{name}} can become something new, once in its life. You choose, or keep it as it is.
saucelings.evolve.undoNote: {{name}} goes back to how it looked before. Evolve… comes back with the same two choices.
saucelings.evolve.title: What could {{name}} become?
saucelings.evolve.writing: {{caretaker}} is thinking about what {{name}} could become…
saucelings.voice.title: Give {{name}} their own voice?
saucelings.voice.body: {{name}} has no voice of their own yet, so their stock lines are generic. Saucelings can read their character card once with your writing connection to learn how they talk, what they call your pet and what they say at mealtimes.
saucelings.voice.failed: Couldn't make {{name}}'s voice: the writing connection didn't answer.
saucelings.stage.tapHint: Tap the stage and {{name}} comes over.
saucelings.tour.eggBody: {{caretaker}} looks after it while you're away. When something runs low, it's your turn to help.
saucelings.tour.petBody: {{caretaker}} looks after it while you're away. When something runs low, it's your turn to help.
saucelings.tour.metersBody: These bars show how it feels. Tap a name to see what it means.
saucelings.tour.careBody: Use these when a bar runs low. Each one rests for a while after you use it.
saucelings.tour.caretakerBody: Check in to hear how things are going, or Ask them to care for it differently.
saucelings.tour.aboutBody: Name it, change its look, or change who looks after it here.
saucelings.tour.tabsBody: The Journal keeps a diary, the Album holds paintings, the Menagerie keeps retired saucelings, and Settings has your connections.
